resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com gives 1930 for the crow's nest, Forest Lookouts gives c.1930, and Idaho Fire Lookouts gives the 1930s. Read here as one early crow's nest.
The record and the Forest Lookouts page spell it Couer d'Alene; firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts spell it Coeur d'Alene. The record spelling is a typo.

notes_for_editor: Two coordinate sets disagree by about 1.9 km: the FFLA list gives 47.99567, -116.52182 (used in the record) and the idaho_fl source gives 47.99153, -116.49637. None of the pages read here gives coordinates in its text, so the point is unresolved; a map check is needed before the pin is trusted. No source read describes the site today. A search snippet from hikearizona.com mentions remnants at the summit, but the page returned HTTP 403 to our reader, so this is unverified and worth a human look. AllTrails also returned 403. Do not merge with us-id-cape-horn-peak-2 (Custer/Valley, Challis National Forest), which is a different lookout with the same name. No staffing record was found; Idaho Fire Lookouts says none is documented. Verification pass: the 1930 crow's nest, the 1935 30-ft L-4 tower and the 1952 destruction were confirmed on the firelookout.com, Forest Lookouts and Idaho Fire Lookouts pages. The FFLA list says 'Tower Gone', not 'destroyed', so it now supports only the gone sentence, which carries footnote 4. A footnote was added to the first sentence. No facts changed.
